name: Connect, then message
description: Invite, then branch: message the people who accept, keep following the ones who don't.

steps.note: Hi {{firstName|there}} — I work in the same corner of the market as {{company}} and would like to stay in touch.

then.body: Thanks for connecting, {{firstName|there}}. I'm curious how {{company}} is handling this year — happy to swap notes if it's useful, and equally happy to just stay in touch.
